ebsco_access: Initial search HTTP 403; bounded retry succeeded and full read completed. No exception or access bypass used.
limits: Exact schedules are label-specific, not three independent regimen replications.
2022 EPIC-HR unvaccinated high-risk result is not projected onto all vaccinated adults.
2024 EPIC-SR symptom endpoint nonsignificant; 2026 PANORAMIC/CanTreatCOVID hospitalization/death outcomes did not demonstrate benefit in those vaccinated populations.
IDSA nirmatrelvir section last reviewed October 2025 and literature search predates the 2026 trial.
CDC summary and older Springer text conflict with the current label on severe-renal dosing; current label and IDSA regimen govern.
Warfarin case is single-patient evidence, not a universal adjustment formula.
No nationwide out-of-pocket price or guaranteed assistance eligibility is asserted.
